disability_pct.title: Disability
disability_pct.note: Disabled under the Equality Act: day-to-day activities limited a little or a lot. Crude percentage, not age-standardised. This is population context, not a count of people needing emergency assistance. Census 2021 disclosure controls introduce small changes to counts.

disability_limited_lot_pct.title: Disability · activities limited a lot
disability_limited_lot_pct.note: Usual residents whose day-to-day activities were limited a lot by a long-term physical or mental health condition. Crude percentage, not age-standardised. Confirm specific access needs locally. Census 2021 disclosure controls introduce small changes to counts.

no_car_pct.title: Households without a car or van
no_car_pct.short: Households without a car or van
no_car_pct.note: Households reporting no car or van available. This measures households, not residents. Public transport, walking and other travel options are not measured; it is not a transport-isolation score. Census 2021 disclosure controls introduce small changes to counts.

geography_note: Census Day 21 March 2021, published for April 2023 local authorities. 294 of 296 atlas codes match exactly. Barnsley and Sheffield use different codes in the atlas; no conversion has been applied. Exact code matching does not make the source periods identical.
